reuse.why: Puts one link guard in accounts/link.ts used by every provider and reuses linkSimpleFinAccount's body for Fintegra, but does so by bending the SimpleFin function, copies Akahu's downloader and re-writes unlinkAccount's reset.

duplication.why: Six near-identical inline guard-then-link wrappers at method registration, a condensed copy of downloadAkahuTransactions for Fintegra and a copy of unlinkAccount's eight-field reset.

placement.why: The link rules are enforced in app.method registration lambdas rather than in the link functions, so calling a link function directly skips them, and Fintegra's linking lives inside linkSimpleFinAccount.

scope.why: Edits stay within the four requested behaviours, though the SimpleFin handler's signature is widened for an unrelated provider.

maintainability.why: A maintainer must know that the SimpleFin handler also serves Fintegra via syncSource/bankId (now also accepted through the simplefin-accounts-link request) and that guards live only in registration wrappers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: linkFintegraAccount and the other link functions are only guarded in the app.method wrappers, and ensureAccountNotLinked re-implements unlinkAccount's reset instead of sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is downloadAkahuTransactions condensed (no logging, 'error' branch dropped); the six registration wrappers in app.ts repeat the same guard call with only the provider string and id path changed.

abstraction_drift.where: linkSimpleFinAccount gained syncSource and bankId (with a bankId ?? orgDomain ?? orgId fallback) so Fintegra can reuse it, and the new ensureAccountNotLinked gained replaceExistingLink; all registered link methods call the guard, but only through per-method wrappers.
